title: New type 2 diabetes: Uzbek, penicillin allergy mentioned once, metformin titration corrected mid-sentence

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Assalomu alaykum. Qanday shikoyatlar bilan keldingiz?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Doktor, oxirgi bir oydan beri ko'p suv ichyapman, og'zim quriydi, kechasi ham ikki-uch marta hojatga turaman. Holsizlik bor.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Ha, ikki oyda to'rt kilo ozdim.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Yo'q. Lekin onamda qandli diabet bor.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Penitsillinga allergiyam bor, toshma chiqqan edi. Boshqa dori ichmayman.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Kecha topshirgan tahlilingiz keldi: och qoringa qand 9,8 millimol, glikirlangan gemoglobin 8,1 foiz.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Vazningiz 92 kilogramm, bo'yingiz 170. Bosim 130 ga 80. Oyoqlarda sezuvchanlik saqlangan.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Tashxis: ikkinchi tip qandli diabet, birinchi marta aniqlandi.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Metformin buyuraman: 500 milligramm, kuniga ikki marta ovqat bilan. Yo'q, birinchi hafta kuniga bir marta kechki ovqat bilan, keyin ikki martaga o'tasiz, oshqozon yaxshi ko'tarishi uchun.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Shirinlik, oq non, shirin ichimliklarni cheklang. Har kuni o'ttiz daqiqa piyoda yuring.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Ko'z tubini ko'rsatish uchun okulistga yo'llanma beraman, yana siydik tahlili va kreatinin topshiring.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Bir oydan keyin qayta ko'rik, uyda glyukometr bilan qandni o'lchab boring.

facts.fact: For 1 month: excessive thirst, dry mouth, nocturia 2–3 times, weakness
No previous diabetes diagnosis; mother has diabetes
Exam: weight 92 kg, height 170 cm, BP 130/80, foot sensation preserved
Diagnosis: type 2 diabetes mellitus, newly diagnosed
Metformin 500 mg once daily with dinner for the first week, then twice daily with meals (the initial 'twice daily from the start' was corrected)
Limit sweets, white bread and sugary drinks; walk 30 minutes daily
Referral to ophthalmologist for fundus exam; urinalysis and creatinine
Follow-up in 1 month; home glucose monitoring with a glucometer
